description: Creates distinctive minimalist brand and digital directions by identifying the brand’s strongest signals, removing visual and verbal noise, simplifying layouts and systems, limiting typography, color, imagery, components, and motion, and preserving a small number of memorable signature elements. Use when the user asks for a restrained, premium, timeless, quiet, elegant, confident, high-end, minimal, or less cluttered website or brand experience without making it generic.
